parameters.query:
-- Appointments ~24h out (not yet reminded) and ~2h out (not yet reminded).
-- One row per due reminder; `which` tells the sender which flag to clear.
select a.id, a.scheduled_at, a.service_type, a.status,
       p.whatsapp_number, c.phone_number_id, c.timezone, c.name as clinic_name,
       '24h' as which
from appointments a
join patients p on p.id = a.patient_id
join clinics c on c.id = a.clinic_id
where a.status in ('booked','confirmed','rescheduled')
  and a.reminder_24h_sent = false
  and a.scheduled_at between now() + interval '23 hours' and now() + interval '25 hours'
union all
select a.id, a.scheduled_at, a.service_type, a.status,
       p.whatsapp_number, c.phone_number_id, c.timezone, c.name as clinic_name,
       '2h' as which
from appointments a
join patients p on p.id = a.patient_id
join clinics c on c.id = a.clinic_id
where a.status in ('booked','confirmed','rescheduled')
  and a.reminder_2h_sent = false
  and a.scheduled_at between now() + interval '90 minutes' and now() + interval '150 minutes';
